capabilities.title: Prepare the factory workstation
capabilities.summary: Verify the local toolchain, authentication health, disk space, and safe operator setup.
capabilities.whenUseful: Before the first factory run or whenever the local toolchain and authentication health need rechecking.

capabilities.title: Enable the official Expo agent profile

capabilities.title: Continue the project from your phone
capabilities.summary: Guide, diagnose, set up, or revoke optional managed phone access for local Codex and Claude Code sessions without exposing the host or storing pairing secrets.

capabilities.title: Connect required providers

triggerExamples: when firebase, revenuecat, fal.ai, or openai media access is needed and must be connected without leaking credentials.

capabilities.title: Continue an existing app
capabilities.summary: Audit an established repository, review code, reconcile real TODOs, repair the canonical memory bank, and safely resume the best verified task without scaffolding over existing work.
capabilities.whenUseful: When the repository already contains real work and you need code review, TODO recovery, memory repair, and a safe continuation point.

capabilities.title: Run the app factory
capabilities.summary: Turn a reference or idea into an evidence-backed blueprint, app, infrastructure, assets, and internal TestFlight build.
capabilities.whenUseful: When an idea or reference app should be taken through evidence, blueprint, build, and internal iOS delivery.

capabilities.title: Plan a new app with guided gates
capabilities.summary: Use the interview path to validate an idea and define product, design, business, and technical scope.
capabilities.whenUseful: When you prefer a guided product interview before approving the first implementation milestone.

capabilities.title: Get guided help choosing the next step
capabilities.summary: Interview the user on product direction and stage, then route to the smallest useful capability and knowledge doc without making them name a command or skill.
capabilities.whenUseful: When the user only has an idea, asks what the kit can do, or is unsure what to do next and wants to be walked through the options.

capabilities.title: CEO and business review
capabilities.summary: Challenge the opportunity, wedge, channel, unit economics, proof, and go/kill criteria before build scope hardens.
capabilities.whenUseful: Before build scope hardens or whenever opportunity evidence and unit economics need a founder-level challenge; also when deciding which MRR-ladder rung the week serves.

capabilities.title: Product scope review

triggerExamples: at planning checkpoints when the core loop, recovery, retention, analytics, or milestone boundary may be unclear.

triggerExamples: before building or polishing screens that need stronger hierarchy, native conventions, accessibility, and design-system consistency.
